summary: Service names set large in two or three rows that drift sideways in opposite directions (after Fiverr on Mobbin). Hovering or focusing a name turns it full ink, dims the others, slows its row and pops a photo of that service over it; every name links to its service page. Nine or more services make three rows. Reduced motion shows a still, wrapped list of names. Use when the client offers many services with their own pages and wants the range seen at a glance; each service needs a real photo.
